Commentary.Commentary: 271 is the target for West Indies. It is that kind of a total where neither the batting side nor the fielding one will feel under pressure, nor under-confident. It is a final and runs are on the board. Australia will like that. But West Indies like chasing as they have shown in numerous games and they will look to be up for the challenge. Join us at 0245 IST (2115 GMT, previous day) for the run chase.

Shannon Gabriel was perhaps missed at the death. He left the field after bowling his 7th over, during the second drinks break, never to return. He was struggling with his health the whole afternoon and did not look 100 percent. His 2-wicket over in the 31st brought WI back. Holder was excellent till that last spell, picking up 2 wickets while Brathwaite and Benn were economical. Surprisingly, Narine went for plenty today.

It was an on-off innings with the ball for the Windies. They struggled for the first half to bowl consistently but then came back after Gabriel's assault in the 31st over. The next 14 overs went for just 59 but then they leaked runs at the death.

Wade initially just pushed the balls along, seeing out the difficult period against Benn and rotating the strike. He found able partners in Starc and Coulter-Nile as Australia crossed the 230-run mark, which was seeming difficult at one stage. Towards the end, Wade came into his own. The last 19 balls of the innings went for 32 as Wade scored 26 of those, in 13 balls.

That 31st over was the turning point of the innings as the Windies came back. Marsh was dismissed in the 37th over and now, OZ were in some deep trouble with lot of balls left, with the score reading just 173. However, Matthew Wade turned out to be the man-for-crisis for the visiting side as he took up the responsibility to bat with the tail, or the lower order, if the former word is inappropriate to use.

After electing to bat on what appears to be a slow deck, the Aussie openers started off in a breezy fashion but then Khawaja was dismissed soon. We then saw some decent partnerships in the middle order as Australia were going nicely at 152/3 in the 31st over. But then Shannon Gabriel, who had a rough time until then, was called upon and he delivered, dismissing Smith and Maxwell in the same over.
That is an excellent finish from Australia. They have managed to post a decent total after going astray at one stage. 66 runs came in the last 7 overs.

SIX! All frustration in that one shot and it heaps rewards! A loose full toss on the body, Wade stays in the crease and slogs it powerfully to pick up a biggie over the mid-wicket fence. A perfect end, AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 270/9!

Another fullish delivery way outside off, Wade goes hard at it but fails to connect. He is totally frustrated as it is again not called a wide. That was touch and go and it goes in favour of the West Indies this time.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD is the last man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! More importantly a dot ball! Full and on off, Wade digs it out to the leg side. Brathwaite collects it in his followthrough and runs to the bowler's end to disturb the stumps looking at Zampa who was already halfway down the crease. He under-arms it and hits bull's eye to send Zampa packing. Nicely done by Brathwaite and that's the penultimate Aussie wicket to fall.
That should have been a wide! Off cutter outside off, Wade leaves it alone but surprisingly the umpire doesn't call it a wide.
8th ODI fifty for Wade, first against the West Indies.
Wide outside off, slapped to wide long off for another brace to get to his fifty. How important is this knock in the context of the game? I say, very!
Full and wide outside off, Wade cuts it to deep point for a brace. Moves on to 49.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE to bowl the final over of this innings.
Fullish on off, Wade works it to the leg side to keep strike with a single. 12 runs off the over.
Full and on middle, Zampa makes room and smashes it to long on for a single.
Wide outside off, Zampa lofts it over covers for a brace. That didn't come from the middle of his bat but landed safely.
Shortish on off, Zampa punches it to the off side. That came from the top half of the blade.
Full and outside off, driven straight to extra cover. A single for the southpaw.
SIX! Another one for Wade! Off cutter outside off, Wade slogs it hard over wide long on and gets another biggie to his name.
The batsman goes after a wide one but misses. The Umpire signals a wide.
Play and a miss! Slower delivery around off, Zampa looks to run it down to third man but misses out.
Another yorker on middle, Wade digs it out to long on. Pollard dives to his left but fails to stop the ball.
SIX! Wade gets it right! Wide outside off, Wade swings hard and hammers it over wide long on for a maximum.
Yorker on off, Zampa squeezes it to point for a single.
Wade pulls the good length delivery to wide long on and gets a run.
Zampa taps the length delivery to point and gets a single.
Fullish around off, pushed to short cover for no run.
ADAM ZAMPA walks out to bat.

OUT! Holder gets another one! A fullish slower delivery on middle, Coulter-Nile looks to go across the line and massacre it over mid-wicket but gets a top edge to it. The ball skies high in the air straight down the ground and Bravo this time makes no mistake. He comes running across from mid off and pouches it behind the non-striker's stumps. Holder heaves a sigh of relief and Australia slip further.
Shortish outside off, NCN is in two minds and ends up letting it through to the keeper.
Full and on middle, Nathan swings his bat and gets it to deep mid-wicket. A couple of quick runs for the Aussie pacer.
Wade looks to sweep that one but awkwardly places it to short fine leg for a run.
Wade was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.

MISSED CHANCE! On middle and leg, Coulter-Nile goes for a slog down the leg side but gets a top edge to it. The ball balloons high in the air towards square leg. Bravo comes charging in from the deep but overruns and fails to even attempt the catch. Pollard doesn't look happy. Replays show that Pollard as well as Ramdin went for the catch but bailed out.
Wade lofts the length delivery through mid off for a single.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Yorker on off, NCN digs it out and sets off. Ramdin comes running in but somehow misses his under-arm shy at the striker's end. That would have been a big wicket but Wade grins on that occasion.
FOUR! Superbly done! Another one down the leg side, following the batsman. Coulter-Nile flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Slower and wide outside off, Wade slams it to long off for a run.
LANDS SAFELY! Slower and full following the batsman down the leg side. Coulter-Nile chips it in the air but the ball falls safely in the no man's land at short mid-wicket. A single taken.
KIERON POLLARD is back into the attack.
Full toss on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single. There was a misfield but the Aussies weren't sharp enough to steal the extra run.
Landed outside off, Wade again goes for a cover drive but somehow gets it to long off just for a single.
Length ball outside off, Coulter-Nile opens the face of his bat and guides it to short third man for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Wade goes for a cover drive but under edges it to short third man for a run.
Wade plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. Benn at short third man fields nicely to deny a single.
FOUR! Much needed! Short and on the body, Wade connects this time on his pull and picks up a boundary through deep mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full and way down the leg side, Wade misses out as the umpire signals a wide.
Pitches it up on middle, Wade pushes it to long on for a single. That ends Narine's spell, 10-1-55-1.

Short and wide outside off, Coulter-Nile just hangs his bat in the way and guides it through backward point. Pollard chases it down and pulls it back in just inside the ropes to save a run. Three runs taken.
NATHAN COULTER-NILE comes out to bat.

OUT! Stumped! Narine manages a wicket in his final over. A flatter delivery outside off, no real spin on that occasion. Starc is ready on his knees but fails to connect. Ramdin pouches the ball and takes the bails off in a flash. Replays show Starc's back foot was outside the crease and Aussies lose their 7th wicket today.
Short and wide outside off, cut away to point.
SIX! No respect! Tossed up on middle and leg, Starc clears his front foot and drills it high over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Off spinner way outside off, Starc leaves it alone sensibly.
Wide outside off, cut away to point.
Narine to bowl his final over now.
Yorker around middle, Starc looks to dig it out but inside edges it to square leg for a run.
Off cutter on off, 117.5 kmph. Wade pulls it to the leg side for a run.
Full and down the leg side, 140.4 kmph. Starc flicks it away to deep square leg and gets a run.
Wide outside off, Starc cuts it to point for no run.
Slower and shorter on middle, defended to the leg side. Wade sets off immediately but Holder fails to pick up the ball cleanly on his followthrough to allow the batsmen to complete the single.
Starts with a short delivery around off, Wade arches back to let it through. Good stuff from the West Indian captain!
JASON HOLDER is back on, replacing Benn.
Wide outside off, Starc is beaten yet again.
Starc has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drifts it outside off, spinning away. Starc swings his bat wildly for a slog sweep but fails to connect.
Quicker one on off, defended to covers.
A pre-mediated sweep shot on that fullish delivery on leg from Wade. A single taken to square leg.
Floats it up around off, Wade drives it thorugh covers and picks up a brace.
Tossed up around off, driven to long off for a run to end Benn's spell. The West Indian finishes with figures, 10-0-38-1. Top notch!
Pitched up around off, pushed to long off for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
PLAY AND A MISS! Starc goes hard at it but fails to connect. The ball goes off Ramdin's pads to short fine leg. A bye taken in the end.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side, Starc leaves it alone.
Low full toss down the leg side, Starc fails on his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Shortish on off, punched to mid on for no run.
POWERPLAY 3 signalled! Five fielders are allowed outside the circle now.
Full and straight, 83.1 kph, a forward defense to end the over.
WIDE. Down the leg side, 81.9 kph, MW misses out on his sweep.
Down the leg side, 84.4 kph, Matthews gets across and nudges it to short fine leg, Shannon Gabriel dives but parries it through and a couple is taken.
Outside off, 81.5 kph, Wade reaches out, takes it on the full and sweeps it to short fine leg. Wants a single  but is sent back.
UPPISH ! SAFE! Tossed up outside off, 84.1 kph, Mitchell looks to go over mid off but slices it. Luckily for him, the ball does not quite carry to Johnson Charles at long off. A single taken.
On middle and off, 84.5 kph, well defended.

Short and outside off, 90.2 kph, Starc punches it to backward point. Wade wants a single but Starc says "Wait, no!" Fletcher is now in a hurry to get to the ball as Wade is halfway down the track and fumbles. The ball goes through and the batsmen take a couple. Starc apologizes to Wade.
FOUR! Short and outside off, 77.1 kph, Wade goes back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary!
Full on middle, 80.5 kph, driven back to the bowler.

Quicker one on middle, Starc works it to short fine leg but slips and gets hit on the pads. The ball deflects away and Wade calls for a single. Starc takes time to get up and there is a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Starc was in though.
Landed outside off, 86.5 kph, Starc reaches out to drive but gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg.
Full on middle and off, 80.4 kph, Wade reaches out and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, a touch short, 87.3 kph, pushed towards covers.
Full and wide outside off, 89.7 kph, Matthew reaches out to drive but gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg. A run taken.
Shorter in length on middle, 85.2 kph, pushed wide of long on for a single.

FOUR! Starc looking to counter-attack. Full on middle and leg, Starc looks to go straight but does not hit it that well. He clears mid on and just gets it wide of long off for a boundary. Narine would not mind this.
This one arrows in with the angle, slightly short, punched to short extra cover.
Landed outside off, 84.2 kph, Starc lunges to drive but then bails out.
Full and outside off, 87.8 kph, Wade reaches out and sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Very full on middle, Starc dabs it out. Just 2 runs and a wicket from the over, Benn has figures of 8-0-29-1.
MITCHELL STARC walks in at number 8, replacing Marsh. West Indies are in with a real chance to restrict the World Champions under 200.

OUT! Another one chops it on! Landed outside off, short in length, 90.7 kph, Marsh looks to punch it through the off side but the ball turns away, takes the inside edge and hits the timber! Now Australia are in real, real trouble. Still 77 balls left.
Full on middle and leg, 84.7 kph, Wade taps it through the leg side and takes a quick run.
Outside off, 90.5 kph, that is really quick, punched past covers for a single.
On middle, 80.2 kph, Marsh looks to cut but gets an under edge to the bowler.
Full and outside off, 86.9 kph, pushed towards cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, punched past the man at short mid-wicket to long on for a single.
Short around off, spinning in, 86.3 kph, Marsh goes back to punch it to short mid-wicket.
Short again, Wade goes back and steers it behind point. Andre Fletcher chases it down, gets to the ball but overruns it and the batsmen take the extra third.
Short and outside off, 84.1 kph, punched straight to short extra cover.
Silly point comes in for Wade.
Full on middle and leg, 93 kph, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up wide outside off, 86.8 kph, Wade lunges to sweep but misses.
Full and outside off, 85.6 kph, driven down to long off for a single.
Landed on middle and off, 84.5 kph, short in length punched to the same area once more.
More flight outside off, 85.4 kph, pushed towards extra cover once more.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Short and outside off, spinning away, Marsh looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
SULIEMAN BENN to bowl as well.
Around middle and off, Matthew lunges to block. A maiden from Narine.
Full and outside off, punched to that fielder at short extra cover once more.
Short and outside off, 83.4 kph, punched to short extra cover again.
Tossed up outside off, 83.7 kph, Wade reaches out and punches it to cover.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Landed on middle, Wade is squared up but plays it with the turn towards silly point.
DRINKS BREAK.
Full and outside off, Marsh walks into that one and defends it back to the bowler.
Full on leg, 142.4 kph, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, 132.3 kph, Mitchell flicks it straight to Marlon Samuels who fumbles at short mid-wicket and the ball goes through. Sulieman Benn mops it up to his right from mid on. A single taken.
FOUR! Up and over! Excellent timing. Full and outside off, 136 kph, Marsh just pushes this uppishly and clears mid off comfortably!
Half volley outside off, 138.3 kph, driven straight to mid off. Marsh initially thinks about the single but then realizes that he has hit it too well and changes his mind.
Full and outside off, 144.6 kph, defended back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Huge LBW shout, turned down. The arm ball on middle, Wade looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Perhaps that was too high. A single taken, leg bye signalled.
Full and wide outside off, 91 kph, Wade reaches out to drive but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Shorter in length, on middle, 80.7 kph, worked past short mid-wicket for a single.
On middle and leg again, 81.6 kph, flicked straight to Kieron Pollard at short mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, spinning down, Marsh does not pick it, goes back to flick but is unsure and pads it away.
SUNIL NARINE is back on.
MATTHEW WADE walks in at number 7, replacing Maxwell.

OUT! LBW! Second wicket in the over! Has the horse bolted for Australia? Gabriel is pumped up here. He gets this on a length to jag back in, 140.1 kph, Maxwell misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals loudly and the umpire raises his finger! Maxwell walks over to Marsh, has a long chat but then goes on his way. That looked to be plumb. Hawk Eye shows that to be hitting leg stump. Good not to take the review from the Aussies. They are in a spot of bother though, half the side is back and 19 overs are still left. What a crucial time in the game this is.

EDGED! FOUR! Lovely bowling. Landed outside off, 140.9 kph, Maxwell looks to open the face of the bat and guide it to third man but the ball moves away a touch, takes the outside edge and lands short of Ramdin. He is unable to stop it and the ball goes through.
Full and outside off, 141.2 kph, steered straight to point.
A good bouncer outside off, Maxwell sways away from the line. The crowd likes that.
GLENN MAXWELL walks in at number 6, replacing Smith.

OUT! Smith is gone and that is the wicket West Indies needed! Second Aussie to miss out on a half century. Gabriel bangs it in short outside off, Smith gets across to pull but the pace of Gabriel does him in. He is the quickest of all the West Indian bowlers and Smith is hurried into the shot. Gets a top edge which swirls in the air but has gone nowhere. Marlon Samuels calls for it at short mid-wicket and takes it easily. Massive, massive wicket. He was the only batsman who was looking set and comfortable at the crease. West Indies will now look to exploit this out-of-form lower middle order.
Full and wide outside off, 141.3 kph, driven through the covers for a single.
Drifts it around off, driven in the gap through covers for a single.
Pitched up around off, defended watchfully.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Flatter around off at 90.3 kmph, spinning away. Marsh makes use of the extra pace and cuts it through backward point for a crisp boundary.
Serves it short outside off, Smith mistimes his punch to covers but manages to cross for a run.
Flighted delivery on off, blocked to covers.
Wide outside off, punched to the off side for no run.
Smith opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a run.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Full and outside off, Smith drives it through point and picks up a much needed boundary. A valiant effort from the fielder in the deep goes in vain.
Good length around off, driven through covers for a run.
WIDE! Full and way outside off. Marsh goes after it but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Back of a length around off, Marsh dabs it to point for no run.
FOUR! Precise placement! Serves it short and outside off, Marsh slaps it past backward point and picks up a boundary.
SHANNON GABRIEL comes back on.
Slower and shorter outside off, Marsh dabs it through covers and gets a run.
Marsh has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted around off, Smith smashes it hard as the cover fielder fumbles to let go. Smith takes a single to touch the 40-run mark.
Short and wide outside off, Smith taps it to short cover for no run.
On off, Marsh makes room and drives it to long on for a single.
Darts it around off, pushed to mid off for no run.
Marsh drives the length delivery to cover-point and sets off to pick up a single to keep strike.
Good length on the pads, Smith works it to mid-wicket and picks up a single.
On a length around off, blocked carefully.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Back of a length outside off, Marsh goes hard it and ends up with a thick outside edge. The ball flies past the first slip for a run to third man.
FOUR! First one for Marsh! Way wide outside off, Marsh drives it in the gap through cover for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, driven to long off for a single.
Shortish outside off, Smith punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Smith shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Marsh eases the loopy delivery to sweeper cover for a run.

Was there a nick there? No there wasn't. A floated delivery on middle from round the wicket, spinning away massively. Marsh looks to defend it off his front foot but the ball goes past his outside edge and misses the off stump by a whisker. Ramdin fails to grab that one but the sound was probably of the bat hitting the pad.
Smith punches it to the off side for a run to sweeper cover.
Wide outside off, Marsh bottom edges it into the ground for no run. That's a wicket maiden for Carlos!
Back of a length on off, punched straight to covers.
In the channel around off, Marsh opens the face of his bat and works it to point for no run.
Wide outside off, punched to point for no run.
Length delivery on off, Marsh solidly defends it to mid off.
MITCHELL MARSH is the new man in.

OUT! Played on! On a length around off, Bailey looks to poke it to the off side. The ball nips in a shade to catch the inside edge and goes directly on top of the stumps. The bails are off and Bailey is frustrated with himself. That's a huge, huge wicket and Brathwaite picks up the dangerman.
Short and wide outside off, Smith arches back and cuts it to deep point. A couple of runs to end the over. Brings up the 5th 50-RUN STAND between the two in ODIs!
Bailey drives the flighted delivery to long off and picks up a run.
Smith punches the shortish delivery to sweeper cover to pick up a run.
Smith makes good use of his feet and flicks it away to deep mid-wcket for a couple.
Shortish around off, Bailey camps back and cuts it to cover-point. A quick single is taken as the shy at the striker's end is missed.
Floated around off, Bailey comes a step ahead and opens the face ofhis bat to guide it to point.
Almost a replica of the last delivery. This time a single for Bailey to end the over.
Wide outside off, Bailey runs it down to third man and picks up another brace.

LUCKY! A length delivery way outside off, 129.6 kph. Smith hangs his bat in the way but the ball catches the inside edge and goes past the stumps to fine leg. Anguish on Brathwaite's face as the Aussies pick up a single.
Back of a length on off, Bailey pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Bailey has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Smith flicks the length delivery to the leg side to pick up a single.
Flatter down the leg side, Bailey gets back but fails to connect and gets hit on the pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bailey dances down the track and drives it to long on. Smith makes Bailey run for a second as well.
Loopy delivery on middle, driven to long on for a single.
Bailey pushes the floated delivery through covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, from round the wicket. Smith pushes it to covers and picks up a quick single. There is a shy at the striker's end but it's wide. Bailey was in anyway!
In the channel outside off, defended to point. Just a single off it.
Short and wide outside off, Bailey looks to cut it away but the ball ball stays low to goes under his blade. Good take from Ramdin.
Back of a length on off, Bailey gets high in the crease only to watchfully defend it to the off side.
On a length around off, Bailey defends it to the leg side for no run.
Bailey gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Wide outside off, run down to third man for a run.

That is a beauty! Flighted around off, Bailey lunges to defend but the ball spins and bounces past the outside edge. Ramdin fumbles but collects well and Benn appeals for the catch but it is turned down.
The arm ball on middle, 89.9 kph, defended back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, 85.7 kph, punched straight to cover.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, 82.1 kph, Smith goes inside out and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A full toss on middle and leg, 89.8 kph, pushed back to the bowler.
SULIEMANN BENN to bowl now.
Fuller and wider outside off, Bailey reaches out and pushes it to point. A MAIDEN from Brathwaite. That is the second one for West Indies today, with Holder bowling the first.
Another back foot defense, this time to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length around off, defended watchfully.
Landed around middle and off, defended from the crease.

Good delivery to start off a new spell, no looseners, gets this one to jag back in from outside off, Bailey stays back to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but it is turned down. Holder asks for a review off Brathwaite but the bowler turns it down. Good grief, HAWK EYE SHOWS THAT TO BE HITTING LEG STUMP!
CARLOS BRATHWAITE is back on.
Landed on middle and off, 86.1 kph, pushed down to long on for a run to bring up the 100 FOR AUSTRALIA.
Another long hop around off, 87.4 kph, Bailey rocks back to cut but finds short extra cover.
Full on middle, 81.6 kph, GB leans and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Way too short outside off, 84.9 kph, Bailey goes back and cuts it through the covers for a boundary!
Oopsss... tossed up on middle, 94.8 kph, George comes down the track to flick but is beaten in the flight and is hit on the pads.
Full on middle and leg, 91.4 kph, Bailey lunges to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Landed outside off, 120.9 kph, pushed behind point for a couple.
Full and outside off, 116.8 kph, SS lunges and pushes it to cover.
Slightly short around off, 113.2 kph, tucked through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, 121.7 kph, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, 117.2 kph, Steven looks to punch it through the off side but gets a bottom edge behind square leg. A single taken.
Full and outside off, 112.6 kph, Smith gets across and pushes it to the bowler. Pollard mimes a throw to the batsman but does not throw.

DRINKS BREAK. Australia are going along at a pretty nice rate here. They have lost both their openers but they have not allowed their run-rate to dip. West Indies will be aiming to bowl tightly through the middle overs and put pressure on Australia's inexperienced and fluctuating middle order. There has been a drizzle around but it is on and off. As of now, it is the latter.
Full on middle, 90.1 kph, flicked wide of long on for a run. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Short and down the leg side, 83.1 kph, Smith goes back and pulls it to the fine leg fence!
FOUR! That is a wonderful shot. Flighted outside off, 86.5 kph, Smith dances down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Down the leg side, 84.1 kph, Steven flicks it to short fine leg.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE. Down the leg side, 81.7 kph, Smith looks to paddle, just like Dhoni does but misses. The ball goes off Ramdin's pads to short fine leg.
Short and outside off, 79 kph, spinning in, Bailey goes back and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, 112.8 kph, Bailey waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it to third man for a run.
Full and outside off, 111.9 kph, Steven lunges and pushes it wide of mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, 113.1 kph, cut straight to point.
Fuller in length outside off, 121 kph, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off again, 113.8 kph, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, 114.4 kph, a touch wide, Smith looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Full and outside off, 90.4 kph, punched through mid-wicket for a run.
Goes back and flicks it towards the leg side but Kieron Pollard at short leg gets in the way.
Full and outside off, defended in front of short leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, 84.2 kph, Smith goes back and works it behind square leg for a single.
Time for spin. SUNIL NARINE to bowl now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. 6 runs and a wicket from Pollard's opening over.
INSIDE EDGE! FOUR! Wide ball outside off, very full, Bailey reaches out to cut but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the off stump and diving Ramdin to the fine leg fence!

AN LBW APPEAL FIRST UP, turned down. Pollard angles this into the right-hander, from outside off, on a full length, Bailey looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Pollard goes up in an appeal but umpire Kettleborough indicates inside edge. Pollard wants a review but Holder says no. Replays do not detect any inside edge while Hawk Eye indicates it to be going down the leg side.
GEORGE BAILEY walks in at number 4, replacing Finch.

OUT! Finch is gone now and Pollard has struck in his first over! An off cutter outside off, that is what he bowls most of the times, 115.2 kph, Finch looks to slog this over mid-wicket but he is a bit early into the shot. As a result, the ball goes off the inner half of the bat aerially, into the waiting hands of Marlon Samuels at deep mid-wicket. Finch departs after a start and Australia have been pegged back just when they were looking for some quick runs.
Full and straight again, 110.1 kph, now Smith walks across and pushes it with a straight bat to long on for a run.
Full on middle, 107.1 kph, Finch gets across and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
KIERON POLLARD to bowl now.

Interesting. Umpire Joel Wilson has just had a word with the West Indian fielders not to throw the ball on the turf. Fielders usually do it to scuff the ball up which can aid reverse swing. Alert umpiring.
Punches this straight to mid on.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Nudges this through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, 133.7 kph, well defended.
FOUR! Classic batting. Full and outside off, 133.2 kph, Finch goes dead straight this time and bisects long on and long off!

EXCELLENT FIELDING! Pollard showing his football skills here. Full and outside off, 129.2 kph, Finch looks to go inside out but ends up slicing it a bit. The ball lands safely but Kieron Pollard does well to get to the ball from deep point and kicks the ball in. A fielder from deep cover returns the throw. Two runs taken.

TOP EDGE! Well, catch not attempted! Hmmm... hard to tell what was going through Gabriel's mind. Holder feels he should have gone for the catch. A well-directed short ball, around off, Finch goes for the pull but the extra bounce induces a top edge. The ball goes towards backward square leg where Shannon Gabriel is in two minds - whether to come forward for the catch or stay back and protect the boundary. He prefers the second option and the ball bounces in front of him. A single taken. Holder is on his haunches, clearly feeling that the catch could have been attempted. Doesn't matter if a boundary had been conceded.
Outside off, played to cover this time. Good line and length from Holder.
Outside off, back of a length this time, 129.3 kph, pushed back to the bowler.
Very full outside off, 129.7 kph, AF comes forward and defends.
A good short ball outside off, 133.2 kph, extra bounce, Aaron dabs it to cover.

EDGED! FOUR! Sulieman Benn has been stationed at first slip but he is very wide, almost at second slip. Holder keeps this full and outside off, 132.3 kph, Finch comes forward and looks to push it away but gets a thick outside edge which goes right through the conventional first slip position to the third man fence. The stand moves to 31 from 34 balls.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
A replica of the last delivery, punched to covers this time. There could have been a single but the Aussies decides against it.
Short and wide outside off, Smith punches it straight to point on a bounce.
Smith defends the harmless delivery down the ground. That came from the inside half of his blade.
Wide outside off, Finch runs it down to third man for a single.
Slower delivery on off, a repeat of the last delivery as Finch bunts it back to Carlos.
Good length on off, Finch pushes it back to Brathwaite.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes into the attack now.
Low full toss on off, driven straight to mid on. A good over this, just 4 runs off it!
Length delivery on off, defended to the leg side. A quick single taken.
On off, Smith gets across and nudges it to deep square leg for a run.
Back of a length outside of, coming in. Smith is cramped for room but manages to punch it to point. No run taken.
Slower delivery outside off, Smith drives it through point for a brace.
Length delivery around off, pushed to covers for no run.
Shortish around off, Finch punches it to mid on end the over. 16 runs off the over, the biggest so far for the Aussies.
FOUR! Easy peasy! Good length on off. Finch clobbers it easily over Narine at mid on for another boundary. Gabriel is giving it away!

SIX! Gets it into the fence! Full and on off, Finch picks it up with ease and drills it straight down the ground for a biggie. Such was the placement that Gabriel didn't even bother to look where it landed.
FOUR! NATARAJA SHOT! Shortish on off, Finch gets in the position and helps it through backward square leg for a bounary.
On the pads again, Finch leans across and flicks it through wide mid on. Narine chases it down and keeps it to a brace.
Good length on off, defended to short mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, Smith lets it through again. A maiden over for Holder.
Full ball around off, pushed to the off side.
A wide first slip in place! He is actualy standing in the third slip's position. Some plan in motion  here for the Aussie captain.
CRISP LINE! Full and outside off, shaping away a shade. Smith lets it through to Ramdin.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Serves a length delivery on off, Smith cuts it to backward point for no run.
Full and around off, defended watchfully to the off side.
On off, Finch looks to play it to the off side but the ball goes to short mid-wicket off the inner part of his blade.
Good length on off, pushed to covers for no run.
Finch punches the good length delivery to mid on for no urn.
Finch flicks the good length delivery to the leg side for a brace.
Short and on the pads, Finch moves across to pull it away. He fails to connect as the ball goes to Ramdin off Finch's hips.
Finch has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SMITH IS HIT! A good length delivery outside off, late inward movement. Smith looks to block it off his front foot but the ball kisses the back of his hand and goes to Ramdin on a bounce. Smith looks in pain straightaway!
Slower delivery on middle, defended to the leg side.
FOUR! Perfect way to get off the mark! Shortish on the pads, Smith flicks it away past the short fine leg fielder to pick up a boundary off his first delivery.
STEVEN SMITH comes out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAPTAIN STRIKES! That's edged and taken! Good length delivery outside off, moving away. Khawaja looks to punch it through covers but gets a thick outside edge to it. Ramdin pouches it with glee as Holder goes up in an appeal. The finger is up and Khawaja walks back after a breezy knock.
Wide outside off, cut away to point. Superb fielding from Fletcher to save runs for his side.
Shortish outside off, punched through point for no run.
Back of a length on off, Finch pulls it away to deep square leg for another brace. Runs coming easy for the Australians, 10 runs off the over!
On the pads, clipped  away to deep square leg. A couple of runs for Finch now.
In the channel around off, Khawaja flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for an easy single.
FOUR! Superb straight drive! Serves a full  ball on off, Khawaja plays it with a straight bat and muscles it down the ground for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, driven straight to mid off.
Length ball on off, Finch closes the face of his bat and works it to mid on for a quick single.
Wide outside off, left alone by the southpaw. A run-a-ball first three overs for the Aussies!
FOUR! In the gap! Full and outside off, Khawaja taps it into the ground and gets it over short cover for another boundary.
Usman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That's the exact delivery which Finch missed in the last over. A shortish delivery on the body, Khawaja swivels and pulls it through square leg for a crisp boundary.
At awkward length on off, Khawaja tucks it to short mid-wicket for no run.
Length ball around off, Khawaja bunts it back to Holder.
FOUR! That's as easy as it gets! On a length around off, Finch lofts it with ease and muscles it nicely over mid off for a boundary to end the over.
Aaron has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SWING AND A MISS! Short of a length outside off, a poor line and length and was asking to be hit. Finch obliges with a pull but fails to connect.
On middle and leg, Finch half-pulls it straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! First of the day! On a length around off, Finch enjoys the room and punches it off his front foot. The ball goes in the gap through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Finch opens the face of his bat and works it to point for no run.
SHANNON GABRIEL to bowl with the second new ball.
UNEVEN BOUNCE! A length delivery around off, Khawaja is late on his defense as he gets cramped for room. He puts his bat in the way and awkwardly blocks it to the off side.
On the pads, flicked away to mid-wicket for a run.
Play and a miss! That's the line, skipper! On a length outside off, extra bounce off the deck as well. Finch looks to defend it off his front foot but is beaten.
Good length delivery outside off, Finch shows the full face of his bat to defend it to covers.
Full and on off, Finch blocks it nicely.
Starts with a shortish delivery down the leg side, Khawaja tucks it to backward square leg for a run to get off the mark.

We are all set for action as the umpires and the players walk out in the middle. It shall be USMAN KHAWAJA and AARON FINCH opening for the Aussies with the former on strike. For West Indies, skipper JASON HOLDER shall start off with the bowling proceedings. In 3-2-1, let's roll...

West Indies captain, JASON HOLDER says he was looking to bat first as well. Confirms that they have the same team and himself, Pollard and Gabriel are okay too. Adds that they have been getting good starts and hopes to carry on the same way.

Australia captain, STEVEN SMITH says that they will bat. Adds that it's a used wicket and runs on the board first up will help. Confirms there are two changes - James Faulkner and Scott Boland go out, ADAM ZAMPA and NATHAN COULTER-NILE are in. On being asked about his on-field relation with Kieron Pollard, he states that Pollard is a quality player and hopes to stop him today. Ends by saying that hopefully they will put up a good performance. Regarding playing out Narine well so far, Smith thinks that Narine is a quality bowler and they shall look to play him out cautiously.
It is TOSS time! Jason Holder spins the coin and Smith calls it dead right. AUSTRALIA ELECT TO BAT.

The Steven Smith-led visiting side haven't done much wrong and will be the favourites to clinch the series. When did Australia last lose a final? Well, you answer me! West Indies, on the other hand, have surprised everyone by swatting aside the South African resistance and that shall be a confidence-oozing factor in their quest to get on top of the Kangaroos. Join us in a while for the toss.

Hello folks and welcome for the final of this tri-series to be played at the Kensington Oval, Barbados. West Indies took it till their last game to outclass the Proteas and reach the all-important summit clash which they will play against the Aussies.
